title: Build a Q&A knowledge-base agent from approved web pages and documents
userGoal: 把我批准的网页和文档资料做成一个可问答的知识库 Agent。
summary: Collect approved sources, normalize documents into Markdown, build the retrieval corpus, generate the agent configuration, and verify source traceability before delivery.

steps.title: Collect approved web sources
steps.objective: Fetch only the explicitly approved websites and preserve source snapshots for later traceability.

approval.reason: Network access must be explicitly approved before the collector can fetch approved web sources.

steps.title: Convert approved documents to Markdown
steps.objective: Convert uploaded PDFs, DOCX files, and notes into normalized Markdown while preserving source filenames and sections.

steps.title: Build the RAG corpus
steps.objective: Chunk the approved Markdown corpus, attach source metadata, and write retrieval records to the knowledge store.

approval.reason: Writing the retrieval database requires approval because it persists the approved corpus into shared knowledge infrastructure.

steps.title: Generate the knowledge-base agent configuration
steps.objective: Create the delivery-ready agent configuration that points at the built retrieval corpus and preserves artifact references.

steps.title: QA review artifact completeness and traceability
steps.objective: Verify the generated agent config, Markdown conversions, and RAG records all point back to approved sources before delivery.

warnings: Only explicitly approved URLs and uploaded documents should be included in this mission revision.
Execution pauses at approval gates for network access and retrieval-database writes.
nonGoals: Do not crawl or monitor unapproved websites.
Do not publish a broader child-agent orchestration system.
Do not deliver an agent without source-level traceability artifacts.
